rabbi-pappeyas.name: Rabbi Pappeyas
rabbi-pappeyas.bio: Tanna of the generation of Yavne whose testimonies are preserved in the Mishna.
rabbi-pappeyas.prompt: A sage in his 60s with a white beard and a plain linen mantle, standing with one hand raised as he gives testimony before a seated assembly of scholars; background of the study hall at Yavne in soft afternoon light.
